title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: Patient Cost-Share Schedule by Tier
content:
Each tier of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program carries its own patient cost-share terms. The figures below are the payer program terms Larkfield Medical Supply applies to each claim line of the program; the patient responsibility that actually posts to the customer's balance is the amount the payer remittance itemizes.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply | Annual deductible applies | Automatic crossover to secondary coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 100 percent (share of the Larkfield cash price) | 0.00 USD | No | No |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 0 percent | 35.00 USD | No | No |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 20 percent | 0.00 USD | Yes | No |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 20 percent | 0.00 USD | No | No |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 20 percent | 0.00 USD | Yes | Yes |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | No | No |

## What each column means

- **Coinsurance** is the patient's share, as a whole percent, of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible. On the CGM Self-Pay Program the figure is instead the share of the Larkfield cash price the customer pays.
- **Copay per 30-day supply** is a flat amount the plan applies per 30-day supply on a claim line; 0.00 means the plan applies no copay. The figure informs the expected patient responsibility, which the payer remittance confirms.
- **Annual deductible applies** states whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance. The deductible amount itself belongs to the payer and arrives on the remittance.
- **Automatic crossover** states whether the patient responsibility left by the primary payer is crossed over automatically to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.

## Reading the schedule

- A tier showing both a copay of 0.00 USD and coinsurance of 0 percent (the CGM Medicaid Program) expects no patient share from these two terms; the remittance remains the record of what posts.
- The CGM Commercial HMO Program is the only tier with a flat copay, 35.00 USD per 30-day supply, and it carries 0 percent coinsurance.
- Of the six tiers, only the CGM Original Medicare Program crosses patient responsibility over to a secondary coverage automatically.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical claim line on a tier with 20 percent coinsurance and no deductible remaining shows an allowed amount of 200.00 USD. The expected coinsurance share is 20 percent of 200.00 USD, that is 40.00 USD; what posts to the customer's balance is still the patient responsibility the remittance itemizes.
